scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1611 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

slovenia-vrsic-pass-road.story: A 61 km one-way ride from near Kranjska Gora, about 1 h 02 of riding. The stops in between: Vrsic Pass and Trenta. The highest point is about 1,600 m. Vrsic Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
